title: Vibrant Creamy Thai Curry Bowl
description: A delicious, fermented, and creamy Thai curry dish, ovo-vegetarian friendly, served on a hot stone plate.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the lemongrass, galangal, and turmeric until fragrant.
Add the mother sauce and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, palm sugar, and lime juice, and stir to combine.
Add the Thai chilies and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the fermented bean paste and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Cook the brown rice according to package instructions.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of brown rice on a hot stone plate, then spoon the curry over the top.
Garnish with toasted peanuts, fresh cilantro, and a sprinkle of fermented bean paste (if using).
